Riley_CS: FYI GalvanoTech (Enterprise) usage down ~52% for embeddings over 12 days. Renewal ~4w. Procurement pinged for vendor comparison. Champion left last sprint. Need triage + quick retention ask. @Mateo_CSM @Anika_SE any initial thoughts?

Mateo_CSM: Ack. Can you paste the top metrics and link? want to see 7d vs 30d.

Riley_CS: Link: https://redwood.app/accounts/galvanotech/usage — embeds -52% 7d, gen -15%. Active API tokens -30%. No 5xx spike, small rise in 429 bursts.

Anika_SE: Any recent model or SDK changes? embeddings are sensitive to prompt/prefix changes or a model variant.

Riley_CS: Timeline shows they flipped to `embed-lite-1q` on 2026-04-02 and a client-side SDK bump 2026-04-03 per notes.

Priya_Analytics: I'll run a quick cohort: KV hit rate, token-length histogram, and route-level call volumes. Will post a 1-slide summary by EOD.

Sam_RevOps: On credits — we can approve a targeted 14-day reserved pool for their embedding route (up to $6k). Need acct id + last invoice to issue.

Mateo_CSM: Outreach plan: 20-min readout with procurement + eng + PM, present tailored perf/cost delta and propose trial/credit + a short re-onboarding for the new PM.

Anika_SE: I'll prepare a rollback plan to previous embed variant plus a quick checklist: KV hit %, batching config, SDK version, recent prompt/template diffs. Quick self-check they can run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/GALVANO/diagnose`

Riley_CS: Draft message to customer: "Hi team — noticed a drop in embeddings and we'd like 20 min to share a short perf readout, demo a mitigation (trial credit + route reserve), and align on next steps. Are you available Tue/Wed next week? — Riley"

Mateo_CSM: +1. Add "we'll use your traffic to show expected cost/latency impact" to deflect list-price questions.

Priya_Analytics: Posting short slide now.

Sam_RevOps: Sent invoice INV-8899 to Riley. Legal looped for the promo T&Cs. Marking renewal-risk and high priority.
